title: M3Hop-CoT: Misogynous Meme Identification with Multimodal Multi-hop Chain-of-Thought

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal models on the task of misogynous meme identification using the MAMI and MIMIC datasets, leveraging a multi-hop Chain-of-Thought prompting framework to explicitly assess whether a meme targets women.

Assessing zero-shot generalization capabilities on the Hateful Memes and Memotion datasets to detect broader offensive content, including implicit racism, using the proposed multimodal reasoning framework.
